patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layout for case study overviews, featuring a concise text block on the left and a large, representative screenshot on the right.
Dramatic, oversized sans-serif typography is used for the hero statement and the site's footer, creating a strong visual anchor and a confident brand presence.
A minimalist color palette relies heavily on stark black text against expansive white or very light gray backgrounds, with a subtle, cool-toned purple used sparingly as an accent.
Sections and content blocks slide up into view from the bottom as the user scrolls, creating a staggered reveal effect for new content.
The hero image subtly slides up from behind the main hero text as the user scrolls, revealing more of the visual content in a controlled parallax-like motion.

Detailed case study pages follow a consistent structure, starting with a full-width hero image and title, followed by sections like 'The Approach' and 'The Outcome' that intersperse descriptive text with multiple full-bleed screenshots.

technique_notes: Content sections are revealed dynamically by sliding them upwards into the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, creating a sense of progression and discovery.
The hero image is positioned to appear from behind the main hero text, sliding upwards as the user scrolls, which adds depth and a subtle interactive element to the initial view.
A very large, bold text element is positioned at the bottom of the page, and the main content scrolls over it, progressively revealing the oversized text as a distinctive footer graphic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero text ~6-7x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by a clean, readable body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on some UI elements within case studies, otherwise sharp edges for overall layout).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous use of negative space, particularly in the hero and between major sections, contributing to a clean and uncluttered aesthetic).

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and confident use of oversized typography for the hero statement and the 'ROME' footer, which acts as a dramatic, almost architectural, brand signature. This, combined with the subtle scroll-triggered reveals and hero image parallax, elevates it beyond a standard portfolio.
